original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚尼日尔州长称67名矿工被关押后37人死亡
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日尔州州长穆罕默德·巴戈表示，67名手工采矿及涉嫌非法采矿人员被关押在尼日利亚安全与民防部队（NSCDC）拘留室后，其中37人死亡。这些矿工于2026年9月15日和16日在尼日尔州M.I. Wushishi和Lukoto地区被捕。NSCDC最初将死亡归因于疑似疾病暴发，但随后表示实际死因尚未确定，有待医学和实验室检查。

key_facts.fact: 尼日尔州州长称67名矿工被关押在NSCDC拘留室后37人死亡
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Niger State Governor, Mohammed Bago, has disclosed that 67 artisanal and suspected illegal miners were detained in a Nigeria Security and Civil Defence Corps cell before 37 of them died in custody.

key_facts.fact: 矿工于2026年9月15日和16日在尼日尔州M.I. Wushishi和Lukoto地区被捕
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The miners were arrested during NSCDC operations in the M.I. Wushishi and Lukoto areas of Niger State on September 15 and 16, 2026.

key_facts.fact: NSCDC最初将死亡归因于疑似疾病暴发
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The NSCDC had initially attributed the deaths, which were discovered in the early hours of September 17, to a suspected disease outbreak.

key_facts.fact: NSCDC随后表示实际死因尚未确定，有待医学和实验室检查
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: However, the Corps later said the actual cause had not been established and that medical and laboratory examinations would determine what happened.

uncertainties: 死亡原因尚未确定，有待医学和实验室检查
矿工是否确为非法采矿人员尚未证实
事件目前仅有一个来源报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
